messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Information Provision" as it appears in the following examples.
["We're letting you know that you have a new message about your claim in your Online Banking mailbox.", 'An important document regarding the subject line above has been posted to your Document Center.', 'You have a new message waiting for you in the secure area of the Alliance & Leicester Bank website.', 'Your account is limited!', 'Thanks for your order, joker@highwayman.com', "We'd like to inform you that your Secure Messages Center has (1) new message.", 'As a result, your account has been limited.', 'But we have held it for the moment because the amount is over the security borders of our rules.', 'Your payment for the auction you won arrived.', 'We recently reviewed your account, and we suspect an unauthorized transaction.', 'we have temporarily suspended your account and your access to online banking and will be restricted if you fail to update.', 'We are running a scheduled maintenance on our servers.', 'You have 1 Unread secured Alert !', 'Your USA Federal Savings Bank Account is currently locked.', 'During our regularly scheduled account maintenance and verification procedures, we have detected a slight error in your account information.', 'I stumbled on this domiciliary account that has remained dormant for three years now with fifteen million dollars($15m)in it.', 'We detected irregular activity on your Bank of America Card on 7/05/2008.', "Very soon, we'll be making some improvements to Halifax Money Manager, You can expect the same great services you get now.", 'We recently contacted you after noticing an issue on your account.', 'A recent review of your transaction history determined that your card was used at an ATM located in Colombia, but for security reasons the requested transaction was refused.', 'This is your official notification that your Alliance & Leicester Internet Banking services listed below will be deactivated and deleted if not renew immediately.', 'You are receiving this message due to multiple logon errors on your account']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}

message.content: {"summary":"We notify you about new messages, account activity, security concerns, service changes, maintenance, transactions, and actions needed to protect or restore access."}
